newsitem.title: CHINA: Earthquake rocks China's Xinjiang region.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake rocks China's Xinjiang region.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.4 on the Richter scale jolted China's northwestern Xinjiang region less than a day after a slightly smaller tremor hit Tibet, Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.
The earthquake hit the town of Jiashi, already rocked by several deadly earthquakes since the start of the year, at 11.58 a.m. (0358 GMT) on Saturday, Xinhua said.
One person was reported injured in the tremor, and officials said they were investigating whether there were more casualties or damage.
Earlier, Xinhua said a tremor measuring 5.3 on the open-ended Richter scale had jolted China's Himalayan region of Tibet but there were no immediate reports of damage or casualties.
The tremor struck Baxoi county in eastern Tibet at 7.18 p.m. on Friday (1118 GMT), the news agency said.
The epicentre of the earthquake was a rugged, rural region with poor communications, it said.
